system.description:
A collection of tools and supplies for patching up injuries. Versions exist at various tech levels, with different kinds of tools at each:

  • Tech Level 2: Simple tools, such as bandages, dressings, sutures, antiseptics, adhesives to seal wounds, and secure bandages designed to fit snugly over wounds with minimal risk of coming loose.

  • Tech Level 3: A digital diagnosis and assistant device and attached tools that dispense chemical treatments that form a seal over wounds and stimulate natural healing.

  • Tech Level 4: The entire kit is contained within a single wand-like nanotech device which can reknit torn flesh and broken bone, soothe burned tissues, and ease pain.

A First Aid Kit allows a character to treat Injuries a character has suffered. A kit can treat Injuries with a cost of the kit’s tech level +1. A Tech Level 2 kit can be used three times before the supplies are used up. Tech Level 3 and 4 kits are powered and recharge after a Break rest.
